module.purpose: Provides the overlay utility that converts visible collaborators' active scribbles into cached canvas paths and renders them with collaborator-specific color and laser opacity.
module.summary: This module defines the public overlay shape for collaborator scribbles and a rendering utility that gathers scribbles from visible collaborators, converts their points into freehand strokes or circular fallback paths, caches Path2D results by logical overlay identity and rendering inputs, and paints them onto a canvas. It handles incomplete and completed scribble states, zoom-dependent sizing, tapering, streamline configuration, bounded cache lifetime, and laser-specific transparency.
module.businessContext: Supports real-time collaborative drawing feedback such as collaborator ink, eraser, and lasso strokes. Failure removes or visually corrupts remote interaction cues during collaboration.

detail.name: CollaboratorScribbleOverlayUtil
detail.summary: Provides the overlay utility shape for rendering visible collaborators' scribbles, including its overlay type, rendering options, and bounded path-cache state.

specLiterals.role: Default streamline option for collaborator scribble rendering.
Maximum configured collaborator scribble path-cache size before clearing.

units.name: getOverlays

detail.name: getOverlays
postconditions: Returns one overlay for each scribble in the visible collaborators' scribble collections.
Each returned overlay contains the original scribble and its collaborator color.
Each returned overlay identifier is constructed from the collaborator user ID and scribble ID.
invariants: Overlay order follows visible collaborator order, then scribble order within each collaborator.
The returned array is newly constructed for the call.
No overlay is produced for a collaborator with no scribbles.
edgeCases: When no collaborators are visible, returns an empty array.
When visible collaborators exist but all have empty scribble collections, returns an empty array.
When a collaborator has multiple scribbles, returns one overlay per scribble in the original order.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns an array of objects shaped as { id: string, type: "collaborator_scribble", props: { scribble: collaborator scribble, color: collaborator color } }.
detail.summary: Builds collaborator scribble overlay descriptors for every scribble belonging to a collaborator visible on the current page. Each overlay preserves the scribble and collaborator color and receives a user-and-scribble-specific identifier.

specLiterals.role: Overlay type assigned to every returned collaborator scribble overlay.

specTests.then: It returns three overlays in collaborator and scribble order, with IDs collaborator_scribble:userA:s1, collaborator_scribble:userA:s2, and collaborator_scribble:userB:s3; each overlay has type collaborator_scribble and props containing the corresponding original scribble and color.

units.name: render

detail.name: render
detail.signature: override render(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, overlays: TLCollaboratorScribbleOverlay[]): void
preconditions: overlays is an iterable array of collaborator scribble overlays.
Each processed overlay provides scribble points, size, taper, state, and color values compatible with the stroke and canvas APIs.
postconditions: Every overlay with at least one point is rendered as a filled canvas path using its color.
Overlays with no points produce no canvas drawing.
A generated path is cached by overlay id together with the point and rendering parameters used to create it.
If the path cache exceeds the configured cache size after insertion, the cache is cleared.
invariants: A cached path is reused only when the overlay id, point count, final point coordinates, zoom, size, taper, and state all match the cached entry.
Stroke generation uses a size scaled by the inverse of the current zoom, linear start taper easing, disabled pressure simulation, and the configured streamline value.
Completed and stopping scribbles are treated as having a final stroke segment.
edgeCases: An overlay whose scribble has zero points is skipped without path generation, cache insertion, or drawing.
A stroke containing fewer than four points is rendered as a circular fallback path centered on the last point with radius scribble.size divided by twice the zoom.
A cached entry with any changed tracked parameter is discarded for rendering and replaced with a newly generated path.
When the cache grows beyond the configured cache size, all cached paths are cleared after the newly generated entry is inserted.
stateMutations: Mutates the instance path cache keyed by overlay id by inserting generated paths.
May clear the instance path cache when its size exceeds the configured cache size.
Mutates the supplied CanvasRenderingContext2D fillStyle while rendering.
detail.summary: Renders each non-empty collaborator scribble overlay onto the supplied canvas context using its color and current editor zoom. Reuses cached paths when the scribble and rendering parameters are unchanged, and updates the path cache when necessary.

specLiterals.role: Scribble state indicating that stroke generation should include the final segment.
Scribble state indicating that stroke generation should include the final segment.

specTests.when: render is called with a valid canvas context.
specTests.then: The empty scribble is ignored, while the non-empty scribble receives a filled path using its color.

specTests.when: render is called for that overlay.
specTests.then: The cached Path2D is reused rather than generating a new stroke path.
The rendered path is a circular fallback centered at the scribble's final point, with radius scribble.size divided by twice the current zoom.
